fashionVideoWorkflow.interaction: Short-video editors retain separate main and optional endFrame fields. Long-video editors show separate image and video reference rows, with independent uploads and counts: up to 9 images including inherited main, and 3 videos. Reorder and renumber within the same media type only; preserve each source binding and inherited main identity. Each node image-picker confirmation creates a fresh UUID canvas image; the same URL may be selected again in later confirmations and counts separately. Deduplicate images by URL only within one confirmation batch. Videos retain URL deduplication and existing canvas-source reuse. Every editor input has a canvas media source and a fixed automatic business association. Non-interactive editor space remains draggable.
fashionVideoWorkflow.generation: Disable the native generation button until required inputs are complete: short video needs a main image and non-whitespace prompt, with an optional end frame; professional video needs at least one image or video and a non-whitespace prompt. Video-only references are valid. The callback uses the same readiness predicate and returns when incomplete without opening a picker or focusing an empty field. Ready video editors append a fixed local demo video bound to the generating editor. Real AI generation and smart expansion services are not connected. Smart expansion only saves configuration; it never rewrites content, creates tasks or charges.

firstLastFrameLayout.emptyEntry: Keep independent main-image and optional end-frame upload cards, using the existing single-image AssetPicker.
firstLastFrameLayout.removal: Hover delete is at the thumbnail top right. Delete clears only that frame and retains the canvas source, editor, prompt, settings and other frame. Remove the source/editor line only when no remaining slot uses it. End frame is never promoted to main. Support undo.
firstLastFrameLayout.entry: Initial videoGeneration creates the empty short-video editor. The image toolbar short-video action inherits the actual selected image.

connections.binding: Both main and endFrame retain their canvas source association. Each image selected inside the editor creates a fresh UUID canvas image and automatic business line in one undo transaction, including the same image selected separately for main and end frame. Place each image 80 units left of the editor with collision avoidance. The image-toolbar entry keeps the inherited original image ID. Draw one line per source ID/editor pair; distinct IDs sharing a URL remain distinct lines. No ports, free edges or manual reconnect interactions.

multipleReferenceLayout.title: 专业服装视频
multipleReferenceLayout.upload: Separate image and video upload actions with separate current/maximum counts. Decode local videos before applying; errors preserve existing content. Every accepted image creates a fresh UUID canvas image 80 units left of the editor with collision avoidance, even if its URL already exists on the canvas or in the node. Bind each new image to this editor atomically with the batch. Videos retain existing media-kind/URL reuse and deduplication.
multipleReferenceLayout.ordering: Reorder only within the same media type. The dragged tile follows the pointer directly; adjacent tiles shift to make room with 200ms ease-out motion. Release immediately applies final positions and numbering, cancels unfinished position animations and adds no settling animation. Alt+Left/Right reorder retains 200ms ease-out position animation; reduced motion switches immediately. Dragging previews order only; drop commits once as one undo action, while cancellation immediately restores the original order without adding history. Preserve canvas media IDs, every source binding, inherited main identity and automatic links; never rebind by position.
multipleReferenceLayout.media: Preview and top-right hover delete for every thumbnail. Delete clears only that reference, retaining the canvas source and editor configuration; remove its automatic line only when no other input uses that source. Canvas videos retain the original video and poster for playback and download.
multipleReferenceLayout.deduplication: Images: deduplicate by URL only within a single confirmed batch; do not exclude inherited-main or existing-reference URLs from the image picker. Later confirmations may add the same URL again, each with a new canvas ID, independent capacity count and line. Reference identity uses sourceImageId, falling back to reference.id for legacy inputs. Videos: retain URL deduplication across current references in picker exclusions and local confirmation.
multipleReferenceLayout.generationRequirement: At least one image or video plus a non-empty prompt; video-only references are valid.

sharedGenerationControls.existingValues: Retain valid existing per-node choices; only newly created short-video nodes and unsupported fast-mode resolution fallback use 768p. Use shared menus and Beta Slider.
sharedGenerationControls.footer: One full-width generation button with unchanged cost 999.
sharedGenerationControls.modeSelection: Inside the existing expanded generation settings menu; retain selected values and new-editor Auto defaults.

fashionVideoWorkflow.editorSelection: Image-toolbar and blank-canvas menu create separate short or professional fashion video editors. Image-toolbar creation inherits the actual selected image; blank-canvas creation uses the right-click world position. No mode tabs or free connections.

smartExpand.placement: Right of the inline video-description title; synchronized in the expanded header through PromptTools.expandedHeaderAction.
smartExpand.state: Per node, with missing values treated as false. Share one state between inline and expanded controls. Existing configuration commit and undo/redo apply. Typing, clearing and applying prompts do not change the setting.
smartExpand.service: Configuration only; no automatic text rewrite or AI request.
smartExpand.motion: 200ms ease-out for thumb and colors; immediate with reduced motion.
smartExpand.accessibility: Focusable switch with aria-checked; keyboard activation and disabled state; interaction does not drag the node.

fixedBusinessAssociations.mode: Use the same fixed business association model as the fusion canvas. Retain normal video editors, editor uploads, reference videos and canvas media interactions.
fixedBusinessAssociations.creation: Image toolbar video-generation actions create a short-video or long-video editor and inherit the selected canvas image ID in one undo transaction. Every main, end-frame and image-reference selection inside an editor creates a fresh UUID canvas image and automatic association, even for an already present URL; commit each confirmation batch and its bindings together. Video-reference uploads retain existing canvas-video reuse and URL deduplication. The initial entry creates an empty short editor; long editors have no hidden main-image requirement.
fixedBusinessAssociations.interaction: Do not show connection ports or provide free dragging, reconnection, selectable-edge deletion or port plus menus. Automatic lines do not intercept pointer input.
fixedBusinessAssociations.geometry: Automatic business lines use the fusion canvas geometry and follow the actual relative left/right positions of media and editor.
fixedBusinessAssociations.selection: Selecting either endpoint shows a brand-color marching line over a dark underlay at layer 4. Otherwise show a gray solid line at layer -1. Do not highlight unrelated branches through group association.
fixedBusinessAssociations.motion: Marching line uses an 800ms linear loop; color transitions retain 200ms ease-out. Reduced motion disables marching.
fixedBusinessAssociations.clipboard: Copy selected image and video media only. Do not copy editors, free relationships or connections back to original nodes.
fixedBusinessAssociations.canvasMedia: Each image confirmed through any video-workspace node picker creates a fresh UUID canvas image instead of reusing an existing URL. This covers material references, grid-split input, back image, short-video main/end frame and professional-video image references. New images use the shared landscape-height/portrait-width limit of 360px and 360px square rule, sit 80 units left of the editor and avoid existing content and earlier images in the batch. Separate confirmations may repeat a URL and count independently; only the current multi-select batch deduplicates by URL. Toolbar-created nodes retain the selected original canvas image identity. Videos continue to reuse an existing same-kind/same-URL canvas source without moving or duplicating it, retaining the original file and poster.
fixedBusinessAssociations.edgeIdentity: Draw one automatic business line per distinct canvas source ID/editor pair, including every main, end frame and image/video reference. Different image IDs sharing a URL keep independent lines. Keep a line while any input in that editor still uses its source ID.
fixedBusinessAssociations.removal: Removing an editor slot/reference detaches only that input and retains canvas media. Deleting canvas media clears all bound slots/references across editors while retaining editors, prompts, settings and unrelated inputs. Deleting an editor retains canvas media. Undo restores media, inputs and derived lines together.
fixedBusinessAssociations.arrangement: Group all connected input media and editors for video-canvas arrangement. Position each canvas source ID and editor only once; do not collapse separate images sharing a URL. Retain reference order and business associations, then fit all content.

userOverrides.workflowMainImageRemoval: Every frame and reference thumbnail supports preview and top-right hover delete. Removing a slot clears only that input, retains canvas media and editor configuration, and removes the line only if no other input uses that source. End frame stays independent and is not promoted. Deleting canvas media clears all of its bindings across editors. All changes support coherent undo.
userOverrides.templateSidebar: Use the same sidebar in content and empty states: 256px desktop width, shared spacing and selection styles, no horizontal divider below the title.
userOverrides.referenceImagePicker: Reuse the existing AssetPicker in single-image mode for adding and replacing garment/model images. Local uploads apply directly after decoding, without a second Use action.
userOverrides.referenceImageHover: Clip the image and hover overlay inside rounded containers.
userOverrides.referenceDeleteOverlay: Place the 24px circular Tonal delete action across the thumbnail top-right corner, offset -8px on both axes. Use BackgroundBlur/S via --background-blur-s with the existing dark media overlay and white icon. Clip only the inner preview, and reserve scroll-container space so the action remains visible and clickable.
userOverrides.workflowBlankAreaDrag: Non-interactive editor space, including blank areas beside frame/reference thumbnails, drags the node. Reference ordering, upload, preview, delete and form controls retain their own interactions.

nodeImagePickerIdentity.source: User requested a newly added canvas image even when the node picker selects the same image again.
nodeImagePickerIdentity.identity: Fresh UUID and sourceImageId binding for every accepted image selection, including repeated URLs across confirmations.
nodeImagePickerIdentity.deduplication: URL deduplication only within one confirmed image batch; independent later selections count separately toward capacity.
nodeImagePickerIdentity.placement: 80 units left of the current editor, avoiding existing and newly added content.
nodeImagePickerIdentity.history: Commit the entire new image batch and current-node bindings as one undo action; removing references preserves their canvas images.
nodeImagePickerIdentity.preserved: Image-toolbar node creation inherits the selected original image ID. Video-file URL reuse and deduplication remain unchanged.

generation.cancellation: Changing category, closing the dialog, leaving the workspace or unmounting cancels preparation. Failed image reads create no partial nodes or task; uploads remain available to retry.
generation.editing: Edit template closes the dialog and appends the resolved input images, configured editor and existing demo result with actual connections. It starts no task. Select the editor, frame the group and commit everything in one undo step.

submenus.behavior: Hover or click to open one group; keep the trigger highlighted while interacting with its submenu. Reuse 120ms intent dismissal, a 4px gap from the trigger row edge with a matching pointer bridge, and 200ms ease-out presence. ArrowRight/Enter enters the submenu; ArrowLeft/Escape returns focus to its trigger. ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigate only the current menu. Outside interaction or a new context point closes the old group.
submenus.positioning: Nested top-layer popovers escape parent clipping. Open 4px beyond the trigger row right edge when space permits, otherwise 4px beyond its left edge; clamp both axes within an 8px viewport inset. When neither side fits, keep the submenu within the viewport with necessary overlap. Constrained menus scroll internally. Japanese menus use 264px width.

blankCanvasMenu.creation: Create any of the six available editor kinds with the node top-left at the original right-click canvas coordinate. Do not avoid collisions or change the viewport for explicit context-menu placement. Shared CanvasContextMenu handles keyboard navigation and dismissal. Fusion and asset context menus are unchanged. Storyboard-to-video and video remake services are not connected.

videoUpscaleWorkflow.title: 视频高清放大
videoUpscaleWorkflow.behavior: Create from video toolbar with source binding. Uploading in an empty editor creates or reuses a canvas video in one undo action. Clearing input keeps the canvas asset. Deleting source clears the input. Require a video and valid resolution to enable generation; the button and callback share the same readiness predicate. Shares automatic business connections, layout and full-screen playback. Backend is not connected.

localDemoGeneration.authorized: 2026-10-23: user requested usable demo results and confirmed images for material generation, videos for video generation.
localDemoGeneration.defaultRatio: auto for newly created material/video editors; preserve existing selections.

textOnlyAutoImage.condition: Quick image generation with zero reference images and ratio auto.
textOnlyAutoImage.display: Use the original square image in the 320x320 placeholder without side bars. Canvas, task thumbnail, preview and download share the same square source.

localDemoGeneration.validation: Native button state and generation handler share the same required-field predicate. Incomplete editors produce no result.
localDemoGeneration.placement: On submission, append placeholders 80px to the editor right with collision avoidance, retaining existing scene positions. Select and fit inputs/editor/placeholders once. On completion, replace the same IDs at their current positions and dimensions without moving the camera again.
localDemoGeneration.connections: Each result has a new ID and generatedByEditorId, rendered with existing automatic business lines. Reuse as a downstream input, arrange by dependency layers, and commit each result batch in one undo operation.
localDemoGeneration.deletion: Delete editor: retain results, clear generator binding. Delete result: retain editor and clear any downstream input reference. Undo restores the full snapshot. Clipboard copies omit original generator bindings.
localDemoGeneration.scope: Fixed local demo media only; no AI, actual upscaling/cropping, prompt-driven result, backend task or charge. Original file ratio and duration remain unchanged regardless of settings.

taskList.component: CanvasChrome.tasks -> CanvasTaskList; Figma 165:30270 reuses v5.3 controls, dimensions, tokens and generating animation.
taskList.disclosure: Click toggles expansion for mouse, touch and keyboard without a background change. Hover, pointer leave and focus changes do not open or close the list. Clicking a result retains expansion; Escape closes. Width, height, header geometry and chevron animate with shared 200ms ease-out, respecting reduced motion.
taskList.lifecycle: Each valid click records an independent running task and immediately adds its connected placeholders using the submitted ratio. After 3 seconds, replace surviving placeholders in place and mark the task completed with the first surviving result thumbnail or video poster. Preserve drag/arrangement positions, dimensions and IDs.
taskList.history: Keep completed records for the mounted workspace session; running count includes only running tasks. The task list remains expandable after all tasks complete.
taskList.removedEditor: Deleting or undoing away the editor or every placeholder cancels its timer and marks the task failed. Surviving slots show a static failure state; restoring old snapshots does not restart generation. Deleted individual slots are not recreated on completion.
taskList.inactivePage: Continue tasks across route changes without moving or focusing the hidden canvas. Clean up timers when the workspace unmounts.
taskList.undo: Each submitted placeholder batch is one canvas undo step; completion adds no undo step. Task execution history is not rewound. Historical slots resolve to completed results or failure when restored.
taskList.examples: On first activation per workspace session, append three completed examples: two image results and one video result, with a quick-image editor and a short-video editor connected through real IDs. Preserve existing nodes and selection; place examples beside the scene. Empty scenes fit the examples immediately. One undo removes the example scene; route changes do not recreate it.
taskList.resultNavigation: Tasks store resultIds and output media store generatedTaskId. Resolve current positions by either stable binding, select and fit surviving results. Copies clear generatedTaskId. Deleted or undone results keep their history but cannot navigate until restored.
taskList.legacyNavigation: Repair missing resultIds from generatedTaskId first. For older one-result demo records without either binding, migrate only complete equal-count groups sharing the exact thumbnail URL: newest submission maps to newest appended unclaimed generated output. Preserve existing bindings and skip ambiguous/deleted groups.

placeholder.sizing: Snapshot the submitted ratio. Portrait width 320px; landscape height 320px; square 320x320px; the other side follows the ratio. Auto uses the first bound input intrinsic ratio, falling back to 1:1. Video upscaling uses its input video ratio.
placeholder.visual: Reuse the v5.3 three-color generating SVGs and 3s linear animation, theme tokens and reduced-motion handling. One placeholder per expected output with the same generator edge and final canvas ID.
placeholder.interaction: Move, arrange, select and delete. No preview, download, copying or downstream editor actions until completed. Completed demo files use contain in the reserved frame without cropping or changing source media.
placeholder.history: Submission is one undo step; completion replaces slots without an additional undo step. Restoring historical slots resolves the task outcome instead of restoring a permanent spinner.

localDemoGeneration.canvasImageFit: Canvas still images use cover, scaling uniformly and clipping overflow at the center to fill their existing frames without letterboxing. This applies immediately to existing image nodes as well as new results. Video posters keep contain; node geometry, source files, full-image preview and download are unchanged.

multiSelectionToolbar.userOverride: Mixed selections show professional fashion video and download only; hide both image-generation actions.
